transcript: Discipline your thoughts. Stop thinking too much. Do not go into the past. Do not go into the future. Both pull your energy away from where life is actually happening. Be in the present. Why? Because only here can the mind become free. Only here can your inner capacity open. When the mind is no longer trapped in memory or expectation, it becomes clear. It becomes light. Now your attention is no longer scattered. Your energy is no longer leaking in all directions. You can fully immerse yourself in whatever you are doing. One breath, one action, one moment. When you are fully immersed, there is no resistance, no rush, no doubt. Nothing is missing. Nothing needs to be added. This is not something you reach later. This is presence. And this means you have arrived. If this speaks to you, the 30-day healing journey was created to help you live this state daily through simple practices that calm the mind, steady the body, and bring you back to balance one day at a time. You can find it in the link in my profile.
